2014_spells.soul-cage.effectSummary: Deal 8d8 necrotic damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.soul-cage.fullDescription: Using 1 reaction, • You can touch a creature and steal its life force. On a hit, the target takes 8d8 necrotic damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt; On a hit, the target takes 8d8 necrotic damage, and you can regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. A stolen soul remains inside the cage until the spell ends or until you destroy the cage, which ends the spell.
